final: WITH race_name_averages AS (SELECT r.name AS race_name, AVG(ds.points) AS average_points FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId WHERE ds.points >= 1.0 GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_points) AS overall_average FROM race_name_averages) SELECT race_name, average_points, average_points - overall_average AS difference FROM race_name_averages CROSS JOIN overall WHERE average_points > overall_average
